operators.notes: Standard nn.Embedding. Should reuse vLLM VocabParallelEmbedding. BLOCKED until Step 4 (real build) completes.
tie_word_embeddings=false so lm_head is a separate [vocab,hidden] tensor. vLLM ParallelLMHead must support sm_120.
23 full-attention layers per the hybrid pattern (indices 3,7,...,91). Must be verified against vLLM's fused QKV cubin for sm_120.
Output projection for the 23 full-attention layers.
FlashAttention-2 or FA-3 must support head_dim=256 and the 23-layer hybrid schedule.
DeltaNet/Mamba2-style linear attention. 69 linear-attention layers per the hybrid pattern. The 'a','b' projections are short; qkv is the dominant one.
Depthwise causal conv1d with kernel=4. Must verify cuDNN or hand-rolled kernel path on sm_120.
Output projection for the 69 linear-attention layers.
Per-head dt bias (Mamba2). 1D vector; trivial to load but kernel must reference it correctly.
Negative-A log parameter. Same shape family as dt_bias.
Per-token top-10 selection over 512 experts. Router semantics (norm? sigmoid? softmax?) is an open hardware question - see Issue #4 Step 8 acceptance criterion #8.
Dense 3-projection MLP per layer. Reuses standard sm_120 cuBLAS GEMM. Activation: SwiGLU. Must verify cuBLAS Lt epilogue supports sm_120.

notes: The key open hardware question. Experts are FUSED into a single gate_up_proj tensor per layer;
existing vllm-moe-router grouped-GEMM kernels for DeepSeek/GLM may expect UNFUSED (separate gate and up) tensors.
(a) the existing grouped GEMM accepts the fused tensor and splits inside the kernel, OR
(b) we must add an explicit unpack step before the grouped GEMM, OR
(c) we must author a new fused-aware grouped GEMM.
Low-bit repacking (INT4/NF4/Q1_0) is the dominant memory story and is gated by Issue #4 acceptance #9.

operators.notes: 1 MTP layer with its own pre_fc_norm_embedding and pre_fc_norm_hidden. RMSNorm, should be triton-fused.
MTP projection concatenating embedding and hidden before the next-token head.

operators.source_shape: mirrors body routed_expert + shared_expert (1 MTP layer, 512 experts, top-10)
operators.notes: 1 additional MTP MoE layer (1 of 92+1). Same kernel compatibility story as routed_expert_grouped_gemm and shared_expert_dense_gemm, but the MTP layer is single-shot per token.

go_no_go_gate_requirements: Step 4: Build vllm + vllm-moe-router on an RTX 5090 (sm_120) and capture build log + commit SHA.
Step 5: Load Qwen3.8 into vLLM on the RTX 5090 and capture runtime startup log (per-operator load trace).
Step 6: Run a small numerical-comparison batch (BF16 kernel vs CPU reference) for at least one operator per category; capture max abs/rel error.
Step 7: Run a mixed linear+full-attention sequence end-to-end and capture wall-clock + per-step status.
Step 9: Only after Steps 4-7 all PASS, flip status to 'passed' and phase1_allowed to true.
(1) Confirm model shape from config (DONE: this artifact's model_shape block).
(2) Confirm tensor naming convention from safetensors index (DONE: this artifact's tensor_naming block).
(3) Confirm hybrid linear/full attention distinction (DONE: this artifact's attention_pattern block).

ac1_no_passed_with_caveats.evidence: status='requires_verification' and phase1_allowed=false. No 'passed_with_caveats' anywhere in this artifact.

ac2_phase1_allowed_false.evidence: phase1_allowed=false at the top level. The corresponding gate in artifacts/qwen38-phase-status.json also has phase1_allowed=false.

ac3_shapes_from_config_2048.evidence: model_shape.moe_intermediate_size=2048, shared_expert_intermediate_size=2048 (not 24576). Sourced from checkpoints/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B/config.json sha256 89391ac8...

ac4_hybrid_linear_and_full_separate.evidence: operators[] contains distinct full_attention_* and linear_attention_* entries, and model_shape.attention_pattern records full_attention_layer_count=23 vs linear_attention_layer_count=69.

ac5_commit_pinning.evidence: provenance.upstream_repository and provenance.commit_sha fields exist. The commit_sha is currently null because Steps 4-5 (real build) have not yet happened. The schema requires it to be populated before any operator can move off BLOCKED.

ac8_router_semantics.evidence: operators[router_topk] notes the open question. Verifying the exact routing semantics (norm? activation? temperature?) is part of Step 5.

ac9_low_bit_repacking_memory.evidence: routed_expert_grouped_gemm notes INT4/NF4 as the target quant. Actual repacking path and memory savings are part of Step 7.

ac10_mixed_layer_execution.evidence: go_no_go_gate_requirements[3] (Step 7) covers the end-to-end mixed linear+full sequence run.

ac11_no_sm120_pass_until_all_pass.evidence: No operator carries compile_status / runtime_status / numerical_status of PASS, and the top-level status is requires_verification. The regression test tools/verify_sm120_kernel_compat.py asserts this invariant and will fail the build if it is violated.

invariants: status must be exactly one of: requires_verification, requires_remediation, blocked, passed, failed. NEVER passed_with_caveats.
phase1_allowed must be false while any operator carries compile_status / runtime_status / numerical_status of BLOCKED.
Every operator must have all of the Step 8 schema fields present (even if value is null).
No operator may have compile_status == 'PASS' or runtime_status == 'PASS' without a non-null evidence_log and a non-null upstream_commit.
operators[] must contain at least one full_attention_* entry and at least one linear_attention_* entry.
operators[] must contain a routed_expert_grouped_gemm entry whose dtype_or_quant mentions INT4 or NF4.
Acceptance criteria ac1-ac5 and ac11 must report satisfied=true; any flip to false must be an explicit, reviewed change.
